The phone app can reach the folders in Android/data through root or Shizuku, and it leaves the message services to the server and the desktop.

## ✨ Added

- **The phone app can sync the folders in Android/data.** Since Android 11, each of these folders is closed to every app but the one it belongs to, ArrowLoop included. Switch on Android/data under This phone, and the folders show up as a target called Android. Through root, ArrowLoop reads and writes them and hands each new file to the app that owns the folder, so the app can still open it. Through Shizuku it only reads them. You pick root or Shizuku yourself, and a way the phone cannot offer is dimmed, with a line that says why.
- **Help for getting root or Shizuku going.** If your root manager renames or moves su, enter its name or path in the su command field. Request root brings up the root manager's prompt again, Ask Shizuku asks Shizuku for access, and Get Shizuku opens its download page while it is not installed.

## 🎨 Design

- **The phone's Appearance card puts Labels and Bottom bar before the colours.** Colour Rotation and the colour palette appear only while Rainbow Mode is on, instead of standing there dimmed.
- **Global sync settings is one wide button** on the phone's Sync card, in place of a row with an Open button.
- **New store screenshots.** Eight pictures instead of six show the 2.0 interface, now with the Overview and Conflicts. The pictures in the README show 2.0 as well.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The phone leaves Matrix, email, Apprise, Healthchecks.io and webhooks to the server and the desktop.** Global sync settings on the phone no longer lists them, and the phone tells you about runs through Android's own notifications. A channel set up on the phone before sends nothing from there, but its settings stay in the configuration as they were. The hint under Report a held job says so too: the message comes as a notification on this phone.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The first job card on the Jobs page shows its whole badge.** The badge was cut off at the top of the page.
- **A running job's card on the phone shows its progress bar.** The bar had no width to fill, so it was missing.
- **The phone app builds with JDK 17 to 21.** The build accepted only JDK 17, and F-Droid's build server runs Java 21.

## 🌐 Translations

- **Every new text is in all 42 languages.**
